data.title: 史尔特尔 · 街角甜品柜前的香草之选
data.location: 街角冰淇淋专门店柜台
data.description: 街角甜品店里，史尔特尔站在玻璃展示柜前逐一审视冰淇淋口味牌。她一手轻轻扶住包带，另一手确信地点向香草口味，神情专注而认真——「就这个。别把旁边的坚果混进去，我要先尝原来的味道。」
data.action: 站在冷藏柜前，单手扶包带，另一手指向香草冰淇淋口味牌
data.promptProse: In profile at a low glass freezer counter, Surtr points through the sloping pane at a shallow metal tub of pale vanilla gelato, her finger stopping just above the glass. Her other hand steadies the strap of her shoulder bag where it crosses a soft grey knit sweater. The pale vanilla sits between a green pistachio tub and a dark chocolate tub, each with a small card clipped to its edge. At the far end of the counter, a register and wall menu anchor the space. Afternoon light from the side window warms the wool and the wood base of the counter, while the cooler freezer light stays on the metal trays.
data.lighting: 侧窗暖光擦过毛衣，展示柜冷白灯照出一排金属冰柜盒
data.animaCaption: In profile, she points down with her fingertip above the glass toward a pale vanilla tub in the row of recessed metal trays. The other hand steadies her shoulder bag strap.
